name: agents-markdown-tools
description: Markdown linting and formatting tools for agent and skill documentation.

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run check:hooks && npm run check:json && npm run check:skills
scripts.check:hooks: bash -n hooks/*.sh && find skills -type f -name '*.sh' -print0 | xargs -0 -r bash -n && shellcheck hooks/*.sh && find skills -type f -name '*.sh' -print0 | xargs -0 -r shellcheck && hooks/test-safety-hook.sh
